name: Catalogue of the Wayward
label: Quest
description: Catalogue of the Wayward: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A finer instrument of justice, Haleh could not have chosen. Read from the catalogue of the wayward and be enlightened.
Should you persist... Should you do what is asked of you... Should you survive... A hero you will make.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hundreds upon hundreds of pages filled with garbled text and symbols make up the brunt of this book.
